text:
Lily: Hey folks — thought it would be fun to run a tiny holiday "shelfie" + snack-swap challenge this week 🎄🏆
Lily: Rules: post a pic of your desk/window/shelf holiday setup, and list one sealed snack you're willing to swap (office drop or ship). Tag your location (SF/NY/etc).
Alex: Ooo count me in. Window lights + mini string of LEDs. I can swap local sourdough cookies (SF). :yum:
Jordan: I’ll join — tiny pine garland + succulents. Can swap a bag of Turkish coffee (NYC).
Maria: Haha my whole shelf is ornaments lol. Can swap assorted tea bags (EU timezone).
Sam: I'm in. No decorations but I have a ridiculous mug collection. Swap: homemade granola (vegan).
Lily: OK sign-up list (copy/paste to reply with your photo):
Lily: ```
- Lily — SF — gingerbread biscotti (sealed) — shelfie attached
- Alex — SF — sourdough cookies
- Jordan — NY — Turkish coffee
- Maria — EU — assorted tea
- Sam — NY — vegan granola
```
DevBot: Reminder: please follow shipping/security: no liquids in mixed boxes, label allergens.
Alex: Voted for "most festive shelf" poll (me -> Lily) :ballot_box_with_check:
Jordan: Quick Q — do we want to set a $ limit or just homemade ok?
Lily: Let's cap $15 value or homemade ok if labeled. Keep it small and fun.
Maria: Photo coming in 20!
Sam: Dropped my pic in the thread (mug selfie). Also adding a tiny GIF reaction. :coffee:
Lily: Love it all. I'll coordinate a drop-off table in the kitchen on Friday 3–5pm and a ship-by date of next Tue for non-local swaps.
Alex: Can we make a tiny spreadsheet? I can throw one in #random as a google link.
Lily: Please do — thx! Also: tiny prize = "golden ornament" emoji for the most creative shelf.
Jordan: Highly competitive energy, I approve.
Maria: Yay holiday cheer :sparkles:
Sam: This is the cutest low-effort holiday plan ever.
Lily: Thanks team — can't wait to see shelfies. Reminder: keep photos PG and office-appropriate. :santa:
